description: Connect ChatGPT to your Floose account to find, read, create, and update notes; save and organize links and addresses; inspect cloud files; and organize ideas on canvases. Create and edit text and code files in Floose Code, or share selected files through read-only public links and email invitations. Vault content is excluded. Access requires a Floose Writer or Advanced account, with Floose Code available on Advanced. Plan checks may initialize or update billing records but do not make purchases or charge the user.
